reviews.comment: Professor Srini's class felt like a joke. The semester-long group project had nothing to do with E-Commerce and turned into a popularity contest over a fake video game political campaign. He constantly made last-minute changes, leaving teams scrambling. Smaller, more focused projects on E-Commerce strategies would've been far more valuable.

Dr. Vijayaraghavan's grad level digital marketing course was alright. This is the first time he has taught this and you can tell. I would have preferred less group project work and more hands on work within e-commerce and digital marketing rather than trying to sell our political candidate. He was very responsive in his emails however. Easy exams!
